entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The decades-long war between Urza and Mishra over the two halves of a Thran powerstone, ending at Argoth with the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The elder brother, a scholarly artificer who became Chief Artificer of Yotia and whose planeswalker spark ignited in the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's younger brother, who led the Fallaji and Suwwardi, was corrupted by Phyrexians, and fought Urza at Argoth.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: An archaeologist, friend of the brothers' father, who taught them about Thran artifacts; she died inadvertently over the stones.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Daughter of the ruler of Yotia, whom Urza wed to win a Thran tome in her dowry.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: A young Fallaji who had been at Tocasia's camp and helped Mishra rise among the Suwwardi.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's student and good friend, to whom Urza said farewell before leaving Dominaria.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: A figure in Mishra's circle whose relationship with him was wedged apart by the Brotherhood of Gix.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Fanatical machine-worshipping priests who infiltrated both sides, became Mishra's council, and betrayed him to Gix.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian to whom Mishra was turned over.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Infiltrators from Phyrexia who corrupted Mishra.

entities.name: Suwwardi
entities.description: A militant faction of the Fallaji who enslaved Mishra and later followed him.

entities.name: Mak Fawa
entities.description: A giant mechanical dragon that rose from the sands and was used to unify the Fallaji.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The ancient artifact Urza used at Argoth, whose blast destroyed the island.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Urza's half of the broken Thran powerstone.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Mishra's half of the broken powerstone, which he found he could control directly.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: A cave of Thran artifacts hiding a sealed gateway to Phyrexia, where the stone was broken.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The verdant island where the final battle took place and which the Sylex sank.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent devastated by the war.

entities.name: Yotia
entities.description: The land where Urza became a clockmaker's apprentice and Chief Artificer.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The explosion that destroyed Argoth, ignited Urza's spark and began the Ice Age.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: A period of extreme cold on Dominaria following the Dark Age, ended by Freyalise's World Spell.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who cast a World Spell to end the Ice Age.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the war and the Dark Age took place.

events.summary: When their father falls ill, Urza and Mishra are sent to study at Tocasia's archaeological dig.
events.quote: he sent them away to his old friend, Tocasia

events.summary: At the Caves of Koilos the brothers find the powerstone sealing Phyrexia and break it in two while each grabs for it.
The brothers' rivalry over the halves causes a falling-out and Tocasia's accidental death.
In Yotia Urza builds a huge machine to move a jade statue, wins the contest and weds Kayla bin-Kroog to gain a Thran tome.
events.quote: He succeeded and was wed to Kayla bin-Kroog

events.summary: Mishra is captured by the Suwwardi and enslaved, and has the Weakstone taken from him.
events.quote: he was captured by the Suwwardi

events.summary: Hajar convinces the Qadir to make Mishra a teacher for his son.
A mechanical dragon rises from the sands and rampages, killing the Qadir; Mishra and Hajar recover the Weakstone and Mishra finds he can control it.
events.quote: The Qadir was killed in the confusion.

events.summary: The new Qadir makes Mishra his Raki and uses the dragon engine to unify the Fallaji under the Suwwardi.
Double-crossings and sneak attacks between the brothers escalate into open war.
At the Fall of Kroog, Urza's avengers are outclassed by Mishra's dragon engines.
events.quote: Urza's avengers were completely outclassed by Mishra's dragon engines

events.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix infiltrates both sides, leading to the Fall of Terisia City.
events.quote: both sides became infiltrated by a group of fanatical, machine-worshipping priests called the Brotherhood of Gix

events.summary: Mishra, having become the Brotherhood's puppet, is betrayed by them and turned over to Gix.
events.quote: Mishra was betrayed by them and turned over to Gix

events.summary: At the Last Battle at Argoth the brothers meet at the head of their armies and Urza finds Mishra corrupted by Phyrexian influence.
events.quote: Urza discovered there that Mishra had been corrupted by Phyrexian influence

events.summary: Urza unleashes the Golgothian Sylex, slaughtering both armies and sinking Argoth, which ignites his planeswalker spark.
events.quote: It slaughtered both armies, blasted the landscape for miles, sank the sub-continent of Argoth

events.summary: The blast ignites Urza's spark, giving him his first brief planeswalk.
events.quote: caused the ignition of Urza's planeswalker spark

events.summary: Urza says a final farewell to Tawnos and leaves Dominaria.
events.quote: Urza departed Dominaria after saying a final farewell to his student and good friend Tawnos

events.summary: The blast brings a Dark Age of cold, scarcity and persecution of magic.
events.quote: The Sylex blast caused a Dark Age on Dominaria.

events.summary: The Ice Age lasts until Freyalise casts her World Spell to end it.
events.quote: until Freyalise cast her World Spell to end it
